starts.note: customer: start when the customer asks to freeze or unfreeze a debit card, or reports a lost, missing or stolen debit card. On such a report the agent offers the documented action for each card: a freeze while the customer is still looking for it (misplaced_freeze_first), or closing once the customer confirms it is lost or stolen (advise_close, handoff_close). A card is frozen only after the customer agrees. This also includes saying yes when the agent, during a CODE 05 decline review, finds the card FROZEN and asks whether to unfreeze it. Unfreeze only a card the customer asks to unfreeze, for example one they found again. One exception: after debit disputes are filed and a card's most severe card_action is freeze_pending_investigation, the dispute procedure requires the agent to freeze that card once (from_dispute_card_action), without a separate request.
starts.quote: When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card

tools.not_used: This job never closes a card. Closing a lost or stolen card is done in closing_cancelling_a_debit_card (handoff_close).
The credit card check after a lost or stolen debit card is frozen runs in lost_stolen_card_cross_product_security_protocol (cross_product_after_freeze).

Say politely that you can help with freezing, closing and replacing the cards right now, and continue with this workflow. Do not transfer on the 1st to 3rd request. steps.do: On the customer's 4th request for a human agent in this conversation, call transfer_to_human_agents. Pick the reason code from the highest tier that applies. Use fraud_or_security_concern only when a fraud or security matter still needs specialist handling. Use request_completed_customer_wants_human_followup when every request was completed and the customer wants a human only to confirm the work or ask follow-up questions. Otherwise use the best-matching code from doc 042. For the code other, put a detailed explanation in the summary.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. Every card the customer named is frozen (or the customer was told why it could not be). Any card the customer recovered, or agreed to unfreeze during a decline review, is unfrozen and confirmed active; a decline-review card was handed back for its remaining checks. If the frozen cards were lost, missing or stolen, the cross-product credit card check has been run (once). Cards confirmed stolen or lost that the customer wants cancelled have been handed to closing_cancelling_a_debit_card. Any early request for a human was answered with an offer to help and counted.
